feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 14 May 2026 3:46pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Thursday, 14 May 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Continuing mostly sunny this evening with only isolated showers, although the northwest winds will remain rather strong and gusty in places, then tonight any showers will die out as winds ease. Minimum temperature tonight 5°C.

Tomorrow will then be a fine and sunny day, and less breezy than recent days with moderate or fresh northwest winds. easing later in the day. Maximum temperature 12°C.


##Outlook##

A dry start on Saturday, but rain and drizzle arriving for the afternoon and evening.

Then dry at first on Sunday before rain arrives later in the day.


##Sunrise##

5:15am Tomorrow


##Sunset##

9:13pm Today
